tools.name: lobby.signup
tools.title: identity: signup
tools.description: Registers a seat for an AID whose OOBI is hosted elsewhere: resolves it through KERIA, persists the member, and replies ok or (error reason). Use signup-with-icp when the browser holds its own KEL. [identity; callable by anyone]

username.description: the seat's login handle, a plain string chosen at signup

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

oobi-url.description: the KERIA-hosted OOBI URL where this AID's key state can be resolved

tools.name: lobby.signup-with-icp
tools.title: identity: signup-with-icp
tools.description: Takes a seat for a browser-made AID from its inception event and signatures, verified offline (AID = k[0], SAID, sig) and witnessed into ^oobi-host; replies ok or (error reason). [identity; callable by anyone]

username.description: the seat's login handle, a plain string chosen at signup

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

icp-alist.description: the AID's inception event as a JSON object (KERI icp fields, serialized)

sigs.description: a JSON array of CESR qb64 signatures over the event, one per signing key

tools.name: lobby.signup-with-kel
tools.title: identity: signup-with-kel
tools.description: Takes a seat under an AID's whole KEL (inception, sigs, rotations in sn order), verified end to end and witnessed into ^oobi-host; replies ok or (error reason). No rotations: use signup-with-icp. [identity; callable by anyone]

username.description: the seat's login handle, a plain string chosen at signup

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

icp-alist.description: the AID's inception event as a JSON object (KERI icp fields, serialized)

sigs.description: a JSON array of CESR qb64 signatures over the event, one per signing key

rotations.description: a JSON array of the AID's rotation events after inception, each a KERI rot object

tools.name: lobby.extend-kel
tools.title: identity: extend-kel
tools.description: Appends rotations continuing from this gateway's last held event for a witnessed AID, each verified against stored state; replies ok or (error reason). Public: a rotation proves its own authorship. [identity; callable by anyone]

rotations.description: a JSON array of the AID's rotation events after inception, each a KERI rot object

tools.name: lobby.join
tools.title: identity: join
tools.description: Grants a seat in this gateway's universal commune to an AID already witnessed in ^oobi-host (empty username mints a handle); replies ok or (error reason). The seat is what keri-authenticate checks. [identity; callable by anyone]

username.description: the seat's login handle, a plain string chosen at signup

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

tools.name: lobby.has-seat
tools.title: identity: has-seat
tools.description: Replies #t when the AID holds a seat on this gateway and #f otherwise, so a client can tell whether to join before authenticating. [identity; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.register-oobi-replies
tools.title: identity: register-oobi-replies
tools.description: Attaches the AID's self-endorsed OKEA endpoint replies (/end/role/add, /loc/scheme) to its served OOBI after each frame verifies under its current key; replies ok or (error reason). [identity; callable by anyone]

replies.description: a JSON array of CESR-framed OKEA endpoint reply events (/end/role/add, /loc/scheme)

tools.name: lobby.fetch-icp
tools.title: identity: fetch-icp
tools.description: Replies the stored ^oobi-host entry (ICP plus rotations) for an AID, or #f when unknown, so a new browser can import the AID and unlock it with its bran, which is the only proof asked. [identity; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.find-icp
tools.title: identity: find-icp
tools.description: Replies the stored ^oobi-host entry (ICP plus rotations) one of whose events carries the given qb64 key as its signing key, the earliest registered when several, or #f when none, so a browser holding only a passcode finds the log by the passcode's first key, verifies it and checks the passcode opens it. [identity; callable by anyone]

event-key.description: a qb64 public key an identity's log carries as a signing key, in an event's k[0] — the first key a passcode derives is one

tools.name: lobby.keri-challenge
tools.title: identity: keri-challenge
tools.description: Auth step 1: mints a 32-byte random nonce bound to the AID prefix and replies it as hex; the nonce expires after 120 seconds and is spent on first use. [identity; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.keri-authenticate
tools.title: identity: keri-authenticate
tools.description: Auth step 2: verifies the signed nonce under the AID's current key, checks the AID holds a seat, and replies (ok session) with a root-tier ^lobby-session bound to that AID, or (error reason). [identity; callable by anyone]

nonce.description: the 32-byte challenge from keri-challenge as lowercase hex; expires 120 s after issue

tools.name: lobby.keri-authenticate-device
tools.title: identity: keri-authenticate-device
tools.description: Auth step 2 for an enrolled device: verifies the root-signed device credential, its live enrollment and the nonce signature; replies (ok session) at tier device within its doors, or an error. [identity; callable by anyone]

wire-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

nonce.description: the 32-byte challenge from keri-challenge as lowercase hex; expires 120 s after issue

tools.name: lobby.leave
tools.title: chat: leave
tools.description: Marks a display name offline, drops it from every meeting room it was in, broadcasts the change, and replies the list of names still online. [chat; callable by anyone]

name.description: on announce/leave the caller's display name; on declare-place the human name of the new place; on declare-need/declare-means the row's own display name, default SPEC (need) or "AGENT's SPEC" (means)

tools.name: lobby.who
tools.title: chat: who
tools.description: Replies the display names currently announced as online on this gateway; the same read as online-users. [chat; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.signal
tools.title: chat: signal
tools.description: Relays a WebRTC signalling message (offer, answer, ICE candidate) from one display name to another's inbox and replies sent, or peer-not-found when the target is offline. [chat; callable by anyone]

target-name.description: the display name of the peer the signal or introduction is addressed to

from-name.description: the display name of the peer sending the signal

signal-type.description: the WebRTC signal kind, one of walkie-offer, walkie-answer, walkie-ice, walkie-cam (on or off: whether the sender is sending video) or invite, room-suffixed

signal-data.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: lobby.ice-servers
tools.title: chat: ice-servers
tools.description: Replies the ICE servers WebRTC peers find each other through, as a list of alists: "urls" always, "username" and "credential" when a relay wants them. The gateway's configuration decides the list; a client carries none of its own. [chat; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.get-mailbox
tools.title: operations: get-mailbox
tools.description: Answers the removed-role-gate error so an old client hears why mailbox access has no wiring; the authenticated session's mesh mailbox doors serve deliveries. [operations; callable by anyone]

identity-key.description: a KERI AID prefix or legacy org pubkey naming the caller; the gate is removed, always errors

tools.name: lobby.online-users
tools.title: chat: online-users
tools.description: Replies the display names connected to this gateway right now, which the contact book joins onto its online dot; presence is gateway-local. [chat; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.has-role?
tools.title: governance: has-role?
tools.description: Replies #f for every AID and role: the role-credential ceremony it read is gone, and the reply shape stays so an old client keeps working. [governance; callable by anyone]

role.description: a role name; the role ceremony is removed, so has-role? always replies #f

tools.name: lobby.get-result
tools.title: governance: get-result
tools.description: Replies a proposal's public tally: (closed . tally-record) for a recorded ballot, (open . live-result) for one still open, or (error ...) for an unknown id. [governance; callable by anyone]

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

tools.name: lobby.list-proposals
tools.title: governance: list-proposals
tools.description: Replies ((proposal-id . status) ...) for every governance proposal, status open or closed, readable without a seat. [governance; callable by anyone]

tools.name: session.whoami
tools.title: identity: whoami
tools.description: Replies the AID prefix this session cap is bound to, so the browser can check the cap it holds is the identity it expects. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.leave
tools.title: chat: leave
tools.description: Unbinds this AID's `browser` channel from the recipient registry and tells presence NAME has left; replies presence's answer. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

name.description: on announce/leave the caller's display name; on declare-place the human name of the new place; on declare-need/declare-means the row's own display name, default SPEC (need) or "AGENT's SPEC" (means)

tools.name: session.present-contact-point
tools.title: identity: present-contact-point
tools.description: Presents this AID's own contact-point credential WIRE (self-issued, blinded, signed): the commune checks it is the presenter's, of a kind it delivers on, and sends a code to the address itself. Replies (ok . pending), or an error. The channel binds on confirm-contact-point. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

wire.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.confirm-contact-point
tools.title: identity: confirm-contact-point
tools.description: Binds the presented (KIND CTX) channel under this AID when CODE is the code the commune sent to that address; replies (ok . #t), or an error for a wrong or lapsed code. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

kind.description: a symbol, sent as its name

ctx.description: the notification channel's destination address for KIND (an email, a push endpoint, …)

code.description: a label's code: the six characters a resource is known by in its scope

tools.name: session.withdraw-contact-point
tools.title: identity: withdraw-contact-point
tools.description: Erases the (KIND CTX) channel bound under this AID and puts down one still waiting for its code — the deletion path for a contact point; replies (ok . #t). [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

kind.description: a symbol, sent as its name

ctx.description: the notification channel's destination address for KIND (an email, a push endpoint, …)

tools.name: session.my-contact-points
tools.title: identity: my-contact-points
tools.description: Replies ((delivers . kinds) (points . rows)): the kinds this commune delivers on, and this AID's durable channels as (kind ctx state) with state bound or pending. Live browser and push bindings, which reconnects rebuild, stay out. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.sync-log
tools.title: commitments: sync-log
tools.description: Stores DATA, the browser's opaque JSON captain's log, as this AID's server-side backup; replies ok or an error with the failure. [commitments; callable by an enrolled device]

data.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.list-log
tools.title: commitments: list-log
tools.description: Replies this AID's captain's log backup as the opaque JSON string sync-log stored, or "" when none is held. [commitments; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.profile
tools.title: identity: profile
tools.description: Replies this AID's member record as an alist of username, display-name and email, or #f when the AID holds no seat. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.update-profile
tools.title: identity: update-profile
tools.description: Sets this AID's own DISPLAY-NAME and EMAIL on its member record, validating a non-empty email; replies ok or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

display-name.description: the profile's display name shown to others

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

tools.name: session.fp-status
tools.title: identity: fp-status
tools.description: Replies (ok . alist) with this AID's personhood standing in SCOPE-ID: person, governor, whether personhood is bootstrapped, and the verified count. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-vouch
tools.title: identity: fp-vouch
tools.description: Issues an unsigned relationship credential from this AID for SUBJECT-AID with relation REL, ending prior vouches; replies (ok . #t) or an error. Prefer fp-vouch-signed when the browser can sign. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

rel.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.fp-vouch-preimage
tools.title: identity: fp-vouch-preimage
tools.description: Replies (ok fields), the SAID-relevant fields of the relationship credential this AID would issue for SUBJECT-AID at AT, so the browser re-derives the SAID and signs it for fp-vouch-signed. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

rel.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.fp-vouch-signed
tools.title: identity: fp-vouch-signed
tools.description: Rebuilds the vouch from the same wire args, verifies SIGNATURE is this AID's own, ends prior vouches for SUBJECT-AID and issues it; replies (ok said) or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

rel.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.fp-withdraw-vouch
tools.title: identity: fp-withdraw-vouch
tools.description: Ends every standing vouch from this AID for SUBJECT-AID; the vouch is the voucher's own to end. Replies (ok . #t), also when none stood. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.give-card
tools.title: identity: give-card
tools.description: Keeps this AID's card for SUBJECT-AID, someone in its contacts: WIRE is {from,to,at,sealed,said,sig}, its content sealed to the receiver and its identifier signed by the giver. The commune checks the signature and keeps the ciphertext, in place of any earlier card to that person. Replies (ok . #t) or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

wire.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.withdraw-card
tools.title: identity: withdraw-card
tools.description: Erases this AID's card for SUBJECT-AID; replies (ok . #t), also when none stood. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.cards
tools.title: identity: cards
tools.description: Replies (ok . rows), one row per person in this AID's contact book with a card either way: the card they gave (its wire, sealed to this AID) and when this AID's own card to them was made. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-request-enroll
tools.title: identity: fp-request-enroll
tools.description: Opens this AID's own enrollment ceremony in SCOPE-ID's ecosystem at the policy's quorum, durable on every witness rail; replies (ok . #t) or an error when already recognised. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-pending
tools.title: identity: fp-pending
tools.description: Replies (ok . rows), the standing enrollment asks in SCOPE-ID's ecosystem with each candidate's progress and vouchers, after expiring stale ones. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-my-ceremony
tools.title: identity: fp-my-ceremony
tools.description: Replies (ok . alist) with this AID's own ask: state none, collecting (count, quorum, witnesses, vouchers) or finalized. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-grant
tools.title: identity: fp-grant
tools.description: The genesis act: a governor issues personhood to CANDIDATE-AID in an ecosystem where nobody is recognised yet; replies (ok . #t) or an error once personhood is bootstrapped. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-open-ceremony
tools.title: identity: fp-open-ceremony
tools.description: A recognised person introduces CANDIDATE-AID by opening their enrollment ceremony at the ecosystem's quorum with this AID as sponsor (K is ignored); replies (ok . #t) or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

k.description: a requested quorum count; ignored, the ecosystem's own personhood quorum applies

tools.name: session.my-phc
tools.title: identity: my-phc
tools.description: Replies (ok . wire), this AID's live personhood credential as a portable card with the issuer's signature, or (ok . #f) when the AID holds none. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.present-phc
tools.title: identity: present-phc
tools.description: Verifies a personhood credential WIRE from another gateway (holder is this AID, issuer signature, trusted issuer) and imports it; replies (ok . #t) or an error. present-bundle takes a whole bundle. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

wire.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.present-bundle
tools.title: identity: present-bundle
tools.description: Verifies a bundle WIRE from elsewhere in dependency order and imports it only when every card stands; replies (ok . newly-imported) or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

wire.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.sync-credentials
tools.title: identity: sync-credentials
tools.description: Stores DATA, the browser's bran-sealed credential blob the gateway cannot read, as this AID's zero-knowledge backup; replies ok or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

data.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.list-credential-backups
tools.title: identity: list-credential-backups
tools.description: Replies the sealed credential backup blob sync-credentials stored for this AID, which the browser decrypts client-side on a fresh device, or () when none is held. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.store-shamir-shares
tools.title: identity: store-shamir-shares
tools.description: Parks the guardian recovery SHARES with SOURCE-AID and THRESHOLD in this AID's user file for later reconstruction; replies ok or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

threshold.description: the number of Shamir shares needed to reconstruct the bran

shares.description: a JSON array of the bran's Shamir shares, each addressed to a contact's AID

tools.name: session.get-shamir-shares
tools.title: identity: get-shamir-shares
tools.description: Replies the guardian recovery shares parked for this AID as an alist of source, threshold and shares, or () when none are held. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.tier
tools.title: identity: tier
tools.description: Replies root or device: whether the passcode key or an enrolled device key proved this session. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.my-devices
tools.title: identity: my-devices
tools.description: Lists the devices this AID's root has authorized, each as a wire alist. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.revoke-device
tools.title: identity: revoke-device
tools.description: Retires the device credential SAID from this AID's registry from either tier, so a lost phone is revoked from the laptop; replies ok or an error when no such device exists. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.relay-announce!
tools.title: chat: relay-announce!
tools.description: Verifies a browser-signed Reticulum announce PACKET-HEX against this AID's KEL-anchored mesh pubkey, registers its destination and forwards it under a 30-per-60 s budget; replies ok or an error. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

packet-hex.description: a signed Reticulum announce or DATA packet as lowercase hex bytes

tools.name: session.send-mesh-packet!
tools.title: chat: send-mesh-packet!
tools.description: Transmits a browser-composed mesh DATA packet PACKET-HEX through the bridge under the same 30-per-60 s budget, refusing any other packet type; replies ok or an error. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

packet-hex.description: a signed Reticulum announce or DATA packet as lowercase hex bytes

tools.name: session.drain-mesh-mailbox
tools.title: chat: drain-mesh-mailbox
tools.description: Drains the ciphertext held for every destination derived from this AID's KEL-anchored mesh pubkey; replies ((dest-hex . #(payload-hex ...)) ...) with only non-empty mailboxes. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.list-credentials
tools.title: identity: list-credentials
tools.description: Lists the credentials in this gateway's own store whose holder is this AID, or () when no store is wired. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.issue-credential
tools.title: identity: issue-credential
tools.description: Issues an ACDC this AID authored (issuer must match the caller) into this gateway's store; refuses unless the caller holds governor standing. Replies the credential's SAID, or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

cred-alist-raw.description: a browser-built, browser-signed ACDC as a JSON object; issuance gate is removed, always errors

tools.name: session.revoke-credential
tools.title: identity: revoke-credential
tools.description: Revokes the credential named by SAID; refuses unless the caller holds governor standing. Governance may revoke any credential by policy, not only ones it issued itself. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.open
tools.title: governance: open
tools.description: Opens a ballot or expression proposal ID in DOMAIN under FRANCHISE as this governor AID, snapshotting voice weights; TARGET-IDS is required when KIND is expression (the distribution's own targets), ignored for a ballot; SUBJECT is an optional "kind:id" the forum resolves against. Replies (ok id) or an error when the id is already open or closed. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

kind.description: a symbol, sent as its name

domain.description: on corpus-search a corpus domain name or #f for all; on open the ballot domain (policy, recomposition, …)

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

franchise.description: who votes: the symbol federation, or the list (scope SCOPE-ID)

target-ids.description: a JSON document, as a string

subject.description: a "kind:id" string the forum resolves an open proposal against, e.g. "recipe:bread"

tools.name: session.admit-commune
tools.title: governance: admit-commune
tools.description: Admits the commune COMMUNE-AID into the federation FEDERATION-AID this gateway holds, at the sturdyref its peer answers at, as one of the federation's governors (the federation's own ladder decides whether it recognises the caller, and its governance policy may require the commune's consent as RATIFICATION, a SAID). The goods that cross are not named: the commune tells the federation what it deals in. Replies ok or an error. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

sturdyref-uri.description: the sturdyref the commune's peer answers at, an ocapn:// URI

tools.name: session.my-grants
tools.title: custody: my-grants
tools.description: Replies (ok rows), the live custody grants this AID holds out: said, spec, commune, until, qty, consume or use, and steward rule. [custody; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.my-titles
tools.title: custody: my-titles
tools.description: Replies (ok rows), the live ownership titles this AID holds: said, resource id, spec and kind. [custody; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.delegation-preimage
tools.title: governance: delegation-preimage
tools.description: Replies (ok fields), the SAID fields of the liquid delegation of FRACTION to DELEGATE-AID — federation-wide, or scoped to SCOPE-ID when given — for the client to sign for set-delegation-signed. Pass the SAME SCOPE-ID there: it is baked into this SAID. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

fraction.description: the share of the caller's voice delegated, a number in (0, 1]

tools.name: session.set-delegation-signed
tools.title: governance: set-delegation-signed
tools.description: Records the delegation of FRACTION to DELEGATE-AID under this AID's own SIGNATURE over the delegation-preimage fields; SCOPE-ID must match the one that preimage was asked for. Replies ok or an error. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

fraction.description: the share of the caller's voice delegated, a number in (0, 1]

tools.name: session.close
tools.title: governance: close
tools.description: Closes proposal ID as this governor AID, recording the tally and issuing a signed tally-result credential for a ballot; replies (ok id) or an error. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

tools.name: session.get-result
tools.title: governance: get-result
tools.description: Replies proposal ID's result with its meta: (closed . tally) once closed, (open . live-tally) while open, or an error for an unknown id. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

tools.name: session.list-delegations
tools.title: governance: list-delegations
tools.description: Lists this AID's federation-default delegations as (delegate-aid fraction mandated?) rows. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.set-delegation
tools.title: governance: set-delegation
tools.description: Records an unsigned delegation of FRACTION to DELEGATE-AID, federation-wide or scoped to SCOPE-ID when given; replies ok. Use set-delegation-signed when the client can sign. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

fraction.description: the share of the caller's voice delegated, a number in (0, 1]

tools.name: session.delegation-mandated-preimage
tools.title: governance: delegation-mandated-preimage
tools.description: Replies (ok fields), the SAID fields of a delegation to DELEGATE-AID carrying the data MANDATE-SPEC — federation-wide, or scoped to SCOPE-ID when given — for the client to sign for set-delegation-mandated-signed. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

fraction.description: the share of the caller's voice delegated, a number in (0, 1]

mandate-spec.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.set-delegation-mandated-signed
tools.title: governance: set-delegation-mandated-signed
tools.description: Compiles MANDATE-SPEC into its predicate and records the mandated delegation under this AID's own SIGNATURE; SCOPE-ID must match the preimage's. Replies ok or an error for an unrecognized spec or bad signature. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

fraction.description: the share of the caller's voice delegated, a number in (0, 1]

mandate-spec.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.revoke-delegation
tools.title: governance: revoke-delegation
tools.description: Revokes this AID's delegation to DELEGATE-AID, federation-wide or for SCOPE-ID when given; replies ok. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-offer
tools.title: stock: machine-offer
tools.description: Advertises this AID's machine as a compute lane in COMMUNE-AID: LANE the lane id, CLASSES the task classes it runs, HEADROOM the offered capacity, REPRO its replay promise; OPTS carry the wire extras. Replies ok or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

repro.description: a symbol, sent as its name

opts.description: a solve's options alist (movable/storable/whole/tau/willing-only/horizon/reproduce/plan-id/displacement-of as the door names); absent runs with every default

tools.name: session.machine-retract
tools.title: stock: machine-retract
tools.description: Withdraws offer OFFER-ID in COMMUNE-AID, this AID its lender; replies ok or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-offers
tools.title: stock: machine-offers
tools.description: Replies the open compute offers in COMMUNE-AID, whoever's. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-submit
tools.title: stock: machine-submit
tools.description: Submits an enveloped job in COMMUNE-AID under TASK-CLASS, wanting LANE, REPRO the replay requirement, INPUT-HASH the envelope's digest; OPTS carry the wire extras. The envelope carries no amount. Replies ok or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

task-class.description: a symbol, sent as its name

repro.description: a symbol, sent as its name

opts.description: a solve's options alist (movable/storable/whole/tau/willing-only/horizon/reproduce/plan-id/displacement-of as the door names); absent runs with every default

tools.name: session.machine-withdraw
tools.title: stock: machine-withdraw
tools.description: Withdraws unclaimed job JOB-ID in COMMUNE-AID, this AID its borrower; replies ok or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-jobs
tools.title: stock: machine-jobs
tools.description: Replies the open compute jobs in COMMUNE-AID, whoever's. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-match
tools.title: stock: machine-match
tools.description: Replies the offers JOB-ID in COMMUNE-AID matches on class and lane, for the borrower to claim one. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-claim
tools.title: stock: machine-claim
tools.description: Binds JOB-ID to OFFER-ID in COMMUNE-AID, this AID the lender on the claim; OPTS carry the wire extras. Replies ok or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

opts.description: a solve's options alist (movable/storable/whole/tau/willing-only/horizon/reproduce/plan-id/displacement-of as the door names); absent runs with every default

tools.name: session.machine-accept
tools.title: stock: machine-accept
tools.description: Accepts CLAIM-ID in COMMUNE-AID, this AID the borrower confirming the work may run; replies ok or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-preempt
tools.title: stock: machine-preempt
tools.description: Lifts CLAIM-ID in COMMUNE-AID before it runs, this AID the lender reclaiming the lane; replies ok or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-claims
tools.title: stock: machine-claims
tools.description: Replies the claims standing in COMMUNE-AID. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-receipt
tools.title: stock: machine-receipt
tools.description: Delivers the executed envelope's receipt W in COMMUNE-AID — digest, metering (tokens or seconds), the lender's countersignature; replies ok or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

w.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.machine-verify
tools.title: stock: machine-verify
tools.description: Replays receipt W's envelope and replies whether the output reproduces — the proof a wrong-result dispute rides on. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

w.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.machine-settle
tools.title: stock: machine-settle
tools.description: Reconciles settlement W in COMMUNE-AID against receipts and the on-chain transfer, governance-cap gated; disputed entries stay held. Replies ok or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

w.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.machine-statements
tools.title: stock: machine-statements
tools.description: Replies COMMUNE-AID's periodic signed settlement statements — bridgeJobId, receipt digest, amount, asset, total, transaction hash. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-envelope
tools.title: stock: machine-envelope
tools.description: Replies job envelope W as kept — the executor fetches it by digest to run; carries no price field. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

w.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.machine-fetch-envelope
tools.title: stock: machine-fetch-envelope
tools.description: Replies the envelope claim CLAIM-ID in COMMUNE-AID binds, this AID the lender whose node is meant to run it; refuses anyone else. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-replay
tools.title: stock: machine-replay
tools.description: Replays claim CLAIM-ID's envelope in COMMUNE-AID — the authoritative answer a wrong-result challenge rides on: receipt digest, reproduced, attestation hash, counter-hash. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-dispute
tools.title: stock: machine-dispute
tools.description: Raises a dispute on CLAIM-ID in COMMUNE-AID, KIND 'non-delivery or 'wrong-result; this AID a party to the claim. Three sortition-selected citizens review; the receipt stays held in full until closure. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

kind.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.machine-dispute-verdict
tools.title: stock: machine-dispute-verdict
tools.description: Records reviewer VERDICT on DISPUTE-ID in COMMUNE-AID, this AID one of the three sortition-selected reviewers; the record closes on two-of-three. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

verdict.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.machine-disputes
tools.title: stock: machine-disputes
tools.description: Replies the disputes open in COMMUNE-AID — raised, reviewing, closed. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-dispute-close
tools.title: stock: machine-dispute-close
tools.description: Closes DISPUTE-ID in COMMUNE-AID past its window or on verdicts in hand; the held receipt's settlement resumes or dies with the record. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-challenge
tools.title: stock: machine-challenge
tools.description: Issues a retention challenge on CLAIM-ID in COMMUNE-AID — a fresh nonce the lender's node must answer with sha256(nonce ∥ held content); this AID the claim's borrower or a governor, CLAIM-ID a live storage claim. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-challenge-answer
tools.title: stock: machine-challenge-answer
tools.description: Answers CHALLENGE-ID in COMMUNE-AID with ANSWER — sha256(nonce ∥ held bytes) as hex; this AID the claim's lender, before the deadline. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-challenge-verify
tools.title: stock: machine-challenge-verify
tools.description: Closes CHALLENGE-ID in COMMUNE-AID — EXPECTED is the issuer's sha256(nonce ∥ content), CONTENT-HASH sha256(content) which must equal the job's committed inputHash; the record lands 'reproduced, 'mismatch or 'failed. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-challenges
tools.title: stock: machine-challenges
tools.description: Replies the storage challenges on CLAIM-ID in COMMUNE-AID — the node's poll surface for what it must answer; this AID a party to the claim or a governor. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-bind
tools.title: stock: machine-bind
tools.description: Lands an AccountLink W in COMMUNE-AID — an Ethereum CAIP-10 account bound to a did:key by EIP-712/EIP-191, dual-signed, or the caller's own AID under keri:<aid>; the linked EOAs stand behind the one bridge identity the grant names. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

w.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.machine-unbind
tools.title: stock: machine-unbind
tools.description: Ends the AccountLink under KEY in COMMUNE-AID — either side may unlink, SIDE naming which ('signer the did:key, 'account the EOA); the record stays, marked by who ended it. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

side.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.machine-bindings
tools.title: stock: machine-bindings
tools.description: Replies COMMUNE-AID's AccountLinks — didKey, account, purpose, status per row. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.machine-payout
tools.title: stock: machine-payout
tools.description: Pays statement W's sends in COMMUNE-AID — every send to the hive treasury Safe the bridge grant binds; no send rail injected answers an honest error, never a phantom payout. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

w.description: a JSON document, as a string
